title: Ashbury Rewards Tier Benefits Chart: Late Check-Out and the Fifth Night on Points
content:
Two stay benefits of Ashbury Rewards depend only on the tier: the latest check-out time the tier is entitled to, with whether that time is guaranteed, and whether every fifth consecutive points-paid night of one reservation is free.

## Stay benefits chart

| Tier | Latest check-out time | Late check-out time guaranteed rather than subject to availability | Every fifth consecutive points-paid night of one reservation is free |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Member | none | No | No |
| Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite | 14:00 | No | Yes |
| Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite | 14:00 | No | Yes |
| Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite | 16:00 | Yes | Yes |
| Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite | 16:00 | Yes | Yes |
| Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite | 16:00 | Yes | Yes |

## Points of judgement

- **No entitlement at the base tier.** Ashbury Rewards Member has no late check-out time and no free fifth night on points.
- **Availability.** At Silver Elite and Gold Elite the 14:00 check-out is subject to availability; at Platinum, Titanium and Ambassador Elite the 16:00 check-out is guaranteed.
- **Fifth night.** Every tier from Silver Elite upward has the fifth-night saving on points-paid nights; Ashbury Rewards Member does not.

## Reading the chart (hypothetical members)

| Tier | Latest check-out | Guaranteed | Fifth points night free |
|---|---|---|---|
| Gold Elite | 14:00 | No | Yes |
| Platinum Elite | 16:00 | Yes | Yes |
| Member | none | No | No |
